scope: Five sampled motion criteria only; not full art approval or measured continuous animation smoothness.

impact_recognition.evidence: Both profiles show white player flash at 0.1 and 0.2 seconds and hull falls from 35 to 27%. Normal material returns at 0.4. Small orange hit is distinct in size and shape from the filled yellow/orange fireball at 1 second.

smoke_fading.evidence: Initial hit dwindles to a few sparks by 0.4–0.6 seconds. Large fireball is gone by 1.5, leaving faint smoke and scattered embers; bright fire absent at 2–3. Continuing thin damaged-aircraft trail follows its turn.
smoke_fading.limitation: Trail is now connected but looks like a granular rope or chain rather than volumetric smoke. Dark fine smoke partly disappears against busy dark water, so fading is less visually legible than against quiet water.

wake_continuity.evidence: Carrier and escort wakes remain visibly attached to sterns and fade outward throughout the sampled turn.
wake_continuity.limitation: Repeated oval segments remain apparent, particularly carrier wake. Foam material looks soft and stamped beside highly detailed water.

camera_motion.evidence: Player moves toward center in early samples then stays tracked through turn; ships and terrain-free ocean translate coherently. No sampled positional jump or orientation reversal.
camera_motion.limitation: Nine timestamps cannot establish micro-jitter or continuous interpolation. Darker water hides shadows better but adds busy texture that may shimmer; shimmer not proven by still samples.

control_visibility.evidence: Bomb and Fire labels and borders retain contrast and fixed placement. Escort behind Bomb at 3 seconds does not obscure label. Hull, heat and objective text remain legible.
control_visibility.limitation: Hawk label intersects minimap edge around 2 seconds. Player merges partially with deck around 0.4–0.6 seconds.

remaining_priorities: Reduce water microtexture contrast to help faint smoke and aircraft shading read.
Give damage smoke irregular wispy volume instead of a connected granular chain.
Improve player separation over the light carrier deck.
Keep ally labels out of minimap; review dense combat motion separately.
limitations: All 18 PNGs actually inspected with view_image and motion.json timestamps reviewed. No source or keys opened. No comparison of simulation timing to actual phone FPS. Acceptance uses the same sampled-event criteria as prior review.
